caption: The video showcases a black Sony 5-disc CD changer resting on a white surface with a sheet of paper on top, its disc tray fully extended to hold two CDs side by side. The front display reads DISC-1 throughout. On the tray, a silver disc labeled NATURESCAPES sits on the left and a black disc labeled Beatles on the right. During the opening moments both discs turn through a small angle, shifting the rainbow diffraction pattern across the silver surface, after which they settle and remain still through the middle. Near the end a person's finger enters from the right edge and rests on the control buttons along the right side. The tray stays open and the two discs hold their positions as the finger works the buttons until the end.
